Alicia is a Research Assistant in the dela Cerna lab. She is currently finishing up her BS in Biohealth Science degree from the e-campus of **Oregon State University**. She holds an **AS in Natural Science** from Holmes Community College. Prior to Georgia Southern, Alicia was a Research Technologist with the Protein Production Core and NMR Core in the **Brown Cancer Center** and the **Department of Medicine** at the **University of Louisville School of Medicinee**.
